tool_calls.input:
const lua = `
local function readfile(path)
  local f = assert(io.open(path, "rb"))
  local s = f:read("*a")
  f:close()
  return s
end
local function headfile()
  local p = assert(io.popen("git show HEAD:tome-cults.lua", "r"))
  local s = p:read("*a")
  assert(p:close())
  return s
end
local function stable(v)
  if type(v) ~= "table" then return tostring(v) end
  local out = {}
  for i = 1, #v do out[#out + 1] = stable(v[i]) end
  return "{" .. table.concat(out, ",") .. "}"
end
local function collect(src, label)
  local out, sec = {}, nil
  local env = setmetatable({}, {__index = _G})
  env.section = function(s) sec = s end
  env.t = function(source, target, tag, special)
    out[#out + 1] = {
      section = sec, source = source, target = target,
      tag = tag, special = stable(special)
    }
  end
  local fn, err = loadstring(src, "@" .. label)
  assert(fn, err)
  setfenv(fn, env)
  fn()
  return out
end
local function shape(s)
  local tabs = {}
  for suffix in s:gmatch("\\n(\\t*)") do tabs[#tabs + 1] = #suffix end
  return table.concat(tabs, ",") .. "|trail=" .. tostring(s:sub(-1) == "\\n")
end
local base = collect(headfile(), "HEAD:tome-cults.lua")
local cur = collect(readfile("tome-cults.lua"), "tome-cults.lua")
assert(#base == #cur, ("record count changed: %d -> %d"):format(#base, #cur))
local changed = 0
for i = 1, #base do
  assert(base[i].section == cur[i].section, "section changed at record " .. i)
  assert(base[i].source == cur[i].source, "source changed at record " .. i)
  assert(base[i].tag == cur[i].tag, "source_tag changed at record " .. i)
  assert(base[i].special == cur[i].special, "args_order/special changed at record " .. i)
  if base[i].target ~= cur[i].target then
    changed = changed + 1
    assert(shape(cur[i].source) == shape(cur[i].target),
      ("LF/TAB/trailing-newline mismatch at record %d"):format(i))
  end
end
assert(changed == 26, "expected 26 target changes relative to HEAD, got " .. changed)
print(("OK records=%d target_changes_relative_to_HEAD=%d non_target_changes=0 line_shapes_match=%d"):format(#cur, changed, changed))
`;
const shq = s => "'" + s.replace(/'/g, "'\"'\"'") + "'";
const luaCmd = `env LUA_PATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?.lua;$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?/init.lua;;" LUA_CPATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/lib/lua/5.1/?.so;;" "$TOME_LUAJIT" -e ${shq(lua)}`;
const cmds = [
  ["LuaJIT bounded delta", luaCmd],
  ["strict lint", "python3 -B tools/i18n lint --strict"],
  ["git diff --check", "git diff --check"]
];
const rs = await Promise.all(cmds.map(([name, cmd]) => tools.exec_command({
  cmd,
  workdir: "/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",
  yield_time_ms: 30000,
  max_output_tokens: 20000,
  sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated",
  justification: "允许我运行用户要求的 LuaJIT 有界差异检查、strict lint 与 git diff 空白检查吗？"
})));
for (let i = 0; i < rs.length; i++) {
  text(`${cmds[i][0]} EXIT ${rs[i].exit_code}\n${rs[i].output}`);
}
